title: TestAStoppedAttemptSPreservedWorkReachesTheNextAttempt is load-flaky under the full gate
body: Under `make gate` on a loaded host (reconcile package: 38 wall minutes against ~5 CPU minutes) the wall-clock test failed with "the run's feed never said a1's wall clock fired", then passed in isolation (20s) and in a full -parallel 12 package re-run (300s). The Makefile header already names host load plus 'the one wall-clock-sensitive test' as the known exposure; it fired. Worth either relaxing that test's wall-clock observation or bounding the gate's exposure to it.
